US tariffs will also be in investors' focus after the Trump administration proposed levies on imports from 14 trading partners, including India, to combat what it calls structural excess industrial capacity.

The US will cap the tariff imposed on Indian imports at 17% if a trade deal is struck between New Delhi and Washington, US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said on Wednesday. If no deal is reached, the tariff would rise to 25%.
